changes: 新增服务端匿名搜索指标；关键词统计默认关闭，明确同意后可开启或关闭。
新增本地 analytics 配置与隐私说明；服务端升级后使用专用搜索接口。
首次使用时尝试检查官方新版，发现更新后征求升级意见，失败不影响搜图。
changes_en: Anonymous server-side search counters; keyword retention defaults off and requires explicit opt-in.
Local analytics preference and privacy disclosure; uses the new search endpoint after the server upgrade.
Try a release check on first use per conversation; offer authorized upgrades without blocking search on check failures.
